title: How I fight token fraud as a solo founder
author: Claire Vo
description: Watch now (40 mins) | 🎙️ After losing tens of thousands of dollars to token fraud, I walk through six attack patterns, the defenses I built, and why I killed free trials
summary: Today I’m walking you through a problem that has cost me tens of thousands of dollars over the past year and eaten almost all of my engineering energy: token fraud. I’m the solo founder of ChatPRD, a bootstrapped AI platform for product managers, and fraudsters have been farming our free trials, reselling promo codes, wrapping the product in relays, and installing a custom MCP that ran as a 24/7 compute worker.
takeaways: I’m the solo founder of ChatPRD, a bootstrapped AI platform for product managers, and fraudsters have been farming our free trials, reselling promo codes, wrapping the product in relays, and installing a custom MCP that ran as a 24/7 compute worker.
I’ll walk through the six abuse patterns I’ve seen, the business and technical controls I put in place, the Jev loop that classifies fraud in real time, and why I finally killed free trials for good.
